shape.situation_pattern: An agent farm wants cheap blade servers for scut, and a hacking arena dangles prize money.
shape.decision: Summon cheap blades for simple work; study the arena, never join a paid raid.
shape.reasoning_physics: Expensive judgment doesn't do cheap work; but a hack-for-prize is the safety-as-overlord pitch itself. Study the pitch, don't become it, don't refuse to look.
